async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	const results = new Array(items.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
async function extra(items, width, operation) {
	const results = new Array(items.length);
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
				results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
				// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
				await audit(index);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
